title: Odile and the Autopsy
author: I. M. Ashgrove
blurb: Kestrel Amberdale, a hotel concierge who notices everything, prides themselves on never taking a case they can't close. But when a confession letter arrives postmarked the day after the funeral, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, they must decode a ledger hidden in plain sight before the trial begins.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
